svg.title: Sequential and pipelined execution
svg.desc: Conceptual batch schedule, not a measured timeline. Sequential work finishes CPU preparation before GPU inference starts. With pipelining, CPU preparation of the next batch overlaps GPU inference on the previous batch. Startup, drain, and slower stages can still leave resources idle.
